what: The Lean intake of OpenAI's Lean proof (GPT-6 Astra in Codex; openai/PrimeGaps186 at 61340d0b), conditional on three declared axioms against the release's own statement file, Challenge.lean: its second axiom, the Kloosterman correlation bound, decided from the run's facts by tools/lean-intake.js (record format 2, instruments/intake/SPEC.md). CERTIFIED here says: the kernels named accept the claimant's proof as a proof of the canonical declaration's own statement; of the planted statements that reached the identity check, every one with a predicted outcome has it, at least one is refused and at least one rewording is accepted; the canonical hypotheses have a model; and every planted defect in the claimant's file is caught. A planted statement that did not elaborate tested nothing and is named, not counted. The spec was written by claimbox (python3 -m claimbox intake spec corpus/intake/pg186-ax2/target.json: every planted statement by a fixed rule, only certain outcomes predicted — "kernel decides" otherwise), copied here by LIFT-claimbox-intake.json and committed before the run.
notDecided: Whether the canonical statement is the informal problem (a reading, F5; F2, instance agreement, was not run). Kernels THIS RUN did not run: leanchecker-paranoid, lean4lean, con-leche, con-ron — another record of the same proof may have run them; this record speaks for its own run only.

F1.canonical:
∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (A B : ZMod p),
  A ≠ 0 →
    B ≠ 0 →
      ‖∑ t,
            if t ≠ 0 ∧ t ≠ -1 then
              IntakeCanon.PrimeGap186.unnormalizedKloosterman2 p (A / t) *
                IntakeCanon.PrimeGap186.unnormalizedKloosterman2 p (B / (t + 1))
            else 0‖ ≤
        8 * ↑p * √↑p
F1.claim:
∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (A B : ZMod p),
  A ≠ 0 →
    B ≠ 0 →
      ‖∑ t,
            if t ≠ 0 ∧ t ≠ -1 then
              PrimeGap186.unnormalizedKloosterman2 p (A / t) * PrimeGap186.unnormalizedKloosterman2 p (B / (t + 1))
            else 0‖ ≤
        8 * ↑p * √↑p
F1.how: the kernel accepts the claimant's PrimeGap186.kloosterman2_correlation_bound as a proof of PrimeGap186.kloosterman2_correlation_bound's own type (taken by type_of%); the two types differ as written and agree after definitional unfolding; the statement is read from a copy of the canonical file with one line added after its imports (`namespace IntakeCanon`: the two files declare the same names and cannot be loaded together), and each declaration used is the original's, constant by constant (3, 3 constants); CONDITIONAL on the canonical file's own axioms PrimeGap186.kloosterman2_correlation_bound: the claimant's proof rests on its axioms of those names, and each is the canonical one, its statement and every definition under it identical name for name (3 constants)
